items.question: What is verified about Moldart as a company?
items.answer: The clearest verified facts used on this site are: Moldart operates from Mumbai, was founded in 1989, works across wood and steel product lines, and uses a sourcing-and-supply model rather than a marketplace model. These points are supported by the internal company profile, the company LinkedIn page, and public business listings.

items.question: Does Moldart only sell products made in one place?
items.answer: No. The site now uses the word 'supplies' deliberately. Moldart operates through Mumbai-led technical and commercial coordination, with supply relationships across India, China, and wider Asia depending on the product line and programme.

items.question: Why does the site avoid some older broad claims?
items.answer: Because this version of the site is intentionally source-led. If a number, superlative, or technical claim is not clearly supported by internal documents or a consistent public source, the site now uses more conservative wording instead of repeating it.

items.question: Where is Moldart located?
items.answer: The primary office presented on this site is: #7, Building No. 1, New Sonal Link Industrial Estate, Link Road, Malad (West), Mumbai — 400064, Maharashtra, India.

items.question: What product groups does Moldart focus on?
items.answer: The site is organised around two broad ecosystems: wood and steel. In practice that includes lamination tooling, decor inputs, engineered panels, flooring and furniture programmes, decorative stainless steel, and industrial press plates for more demanding technical lines.

items.question: Are all specifications on the site fixed commercial promises?
items.answer: No. The product pages are intended to work as verified reference sheets, not blanket promises. Exact grades, finishes, thicknesses, compliance requirements, MOQ, and delivery schedules are confirmed per enquiry.

items.question: Why are some product pages now less detailed than before?
items.answer: That change is intentional. The site now prefers fewer, more reliable technical points over longer pages filled with mixed or weakly sourced claims. If a detail needs project-level confirmation, the page says so.

items.question: Can Moldart still support custom requirements?
items.answer: Yes. Custom sizes, grades, finishes, and programme-specific supply routes are still part of the offer. The difference is that the site now presents customization as an enquiry-led process instead of assuming every option applies to every order.

items.question: Why are many MOQ and lead-time values no longer shown as exact numbers?
items.answer: Because those values change by product, origin, customization level, and current supply condition. To avoid publishing misleading numbers, the site now treats MOQ and schedule as commercial values confirmed during enquiry.

items.question: Can I ask for a reference document before placing an order?
items.answer: Yes. The resources section is now framed as a verified reference library. If the exact document you need is not listed there, you can request it directly through contact or WhatsApp.

items.question: Does Moldart support export and international supply?
items.answer: Yes, but the site now describes this carefully. Export support, documentation coordination, and international sourcing are part of the operating model, while final route, origin, and compliance are confirmed against the actual order.

items.question: What changed in this version of the website?
items.answer: The site was simplified around a less-is-more approach: fewer visible claims, fewer repetitive articles, more emphasis on verified facts, cleaner navigation, better use of visual data, and stronger links between products, resources, and actual enquiry paths.

items.question: How is the insights section managed now?
items.answer: The insights section now mixes deeper source-backed notes with structured buyer guides generated from the curated product reference data. Repetitive filler patterns are still excluded, but the library is larger again because each live article now has a clearer role.

items.question: What should I do if I need a precise answer that the site does not state openly?
items.answer: Use the contact form, WhatsApp, or email and ask for the exact requirement review. This version of the site is designed to avoid guessing in public copy and move precise commercial or technical confirmation into a direct discussion.
